feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 May 2026 8:43am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 27 May 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred in the North Sea.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the south of the area at first. Increasing East or Southeast 5 or 6 later in the evening, then possibly occasionally 7 in a few places for a time tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south of the area, becoming mainly moderate later this evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then scattered showers later this evening and tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, soon decreasing 3 or 4 by tomorrow afternoon. Veering south or southwest 5 or 6 later in the afternoon, then southwest 4 or 5 later in the night into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight for a time during the morning and afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair, then mist and fog patches for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
